narrative.opening: Three metrics, ten models, no simulator. Pick one and defend it.
narrative.why_these_three: mmd, dpp and viol are the columns almost every generative-design paper reports, because they are the columns you can afford.
narrative.habibi: Habibi et al., When Is it Actually Worth Learning Inverse Design? (J. Mech. Des. 148(6):061704, 2026) found kNN beats deconvolutional networks for topology-optimization warm-starting at limited data, once data-generation cost is counted. Two entries in your bank are exactly that comparison.
narrative.same_config_twice: Two pairs in this bank differ only by training seed. If your ranking separates them, some of what you are ranking is the seed.
narrative.manifold: The manifold columns are computed in the latent space of an autoencoder trained on real optima for this problem. They cost the same seconds the pixel columns do -- the difference is which space the distance is measured in, not how much compute you spent.
